test_groupby_aggregations: test groupby aggregations including mean, sum, std, and custom aggregate functions on grouped series
test_groupby_boolean_reductions: test groupby boolean reductions any and all with various data types including nullable dtypes and missing values
test_groupby_idxmin_idxmax: test groupby idxmin and idxmax operations with extreme numeric values and skipna behavior
test_groupby_min_max_nullable: test groupby min and max operations on nullable integer and floating point dtypes with min_count parameter
test_groupby_nunique: test groupby nunique operation with NaT values, empty series, datetime groupers, and dropna parameter
